title: Crime Aid
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael and Holly discuss their budding relationship and the possibility of a date involving sex. Meanwhile, the office deals with a recent robbery, prompting Michael to organize a charity auction called Crime-Aid to recoup losses. Dwight struggles with Angela's engagement to Andy and pressures her to break it off, while Pam faces financial difficulties in New York and is offered a part-time job by Michael. The auction features various humorous and competitive moments, including bids on unique items and escalating conflicts. Several personal confrontations and revelations occur, including Dwight's conflict with Phyllis and Jim revealing Pam's engagement to him. The episode ends with unresolved questions about the robbery culprit, Dwight's ultimatum to Angela, and the outcome of Michael and Holly's date.
